an5.36:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these five timely gifts.
an5.36:1.3: (1) One gives a gift to a visitor.
an5.36:1.4: (2) One gives a gift to one setting out on a journey.
an5.36:1.5: (3) One gives a gift to a patient.
an5.36:1.6: (4) One gives a gift during a famine.
an5.36:1.7: (5) One first presents the newly harvested crops and fruits to the virtuous ones.
an5.36:1.8: These are the five timely gifts.”
an5.36:2.1: At the proper time, those wise,
an5.36:2.3: give a timely gift to the noble ones,
an5.36:3.3: Those who rejoice in such deeds
an5.36:3.5: do not miss out on the offering;
an5.36:3.6: they too partake of the merit.
an5.36:4.2: one should give a gift where it yields great fruit.
an5.36:4.3: Merits are the support of living beings
an5.36:4.4: when they arise in the other world.
